outcome: cesarean delivery in the third trimester
cohort: The study included 72 patients with transvaginal cerclage and 120 patients with transabdominal cerclage who terminated their pregnancy in the second or third trimester at two tertiary hospitals.
finding: TAC patients were associated with a significantly higher incidence of maternal morbidity including placental disorders, abnormal fetal presentation, intrapartum hemorrhage >=500 ml, and uterine rupture compared to TVC patients.
mod_finding: Compared with TVC patients, TAC patients had significantly higher rates of cesarean delivery in the third trimester.
